:::{#def-irreducible-error}
#### Irreducible error

Let:

- $\paren{\newpredvar, \newoutvar}$ be a [new observation](#def-new-observation) relative to the random [training set](#def-training-set) $\trainset$, and
- $\noise$ be the [noise](#def-noise) of $\newoutvar$ at the [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\newpredvar = \predvar$.

The **irreducible error** at $\predvar$ is the [population variance](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/variance-covariance.html#def-variance) of the noise:

$$
\varpar \eqdef \Var{\noise}.
$$ {#eq-irreducible-error}

Source: @wikipedia_bias_variance_tradeoff.
:::
